findings.title: The headline has no emphasis on the phrase that carries the promise

location.description: The two-line headline at the top left of the hero, "Fill every market pitch before Saturday".

findings.viewer_experience: The deadline, which is the reason to act now, reads with the same weight as the rest of the headline, so the eye gets no lead phrase.

current.value: Both lines of the headline are the same size, weight, and dark color.

findings.target: One phrase of the headline reads as the lead; the headline is no longer one flat run.
findings.fix_direction: Give the phrase that carries the urgency visible emphasis within the headline.

closed_when.check: Look at the headline: one part of it clearly leads the eye before the rest.
